job.title: [Post] Preeti Pandey - Senior Java Enterprise Architect 📍 Location

tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with hands-on expertise in backend architecture, system migration and enterprise modernization.

cover_en.subject: Application: Preeti Pandey - Senior Java Enterprise Architect
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Java Enterprise Architect position. With over 5 years of professional experience building and modernizing large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms for industry leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, backend architecture, and complex system integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise Architecture & Strategy
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, establishing scalable architecture patterns and driving system modernization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Platform Migration & Modernization
bullets.text: Engineered complex API migrations for customer account structures and optimized large-scale data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to improve system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Hands-On Java & API Depth
bullets.text: Built and exposed RESTful APIs, microservices, and OCC Web Services while leading database query refactoring that significantly reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved intricate integration bottlenecks between enterprise platforms, collaborating closely with international technical teams and business stakeholders to align architecture with business strategy.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving my notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise architecture and backend modernization experience can benefit your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and Java architecture experience to your organization. Having designed scalable platforms and driven complex migrations for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about the opportunity to shape your architecture strategy and deliver high-performance solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of Java enterprise architecture and e-commerce platform modernization experience to drive scalable, high-performance solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your Senior Java Enterprise Architect opening. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms and driving backend migrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java and integration expertise. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application - Senior Java Enterprise Architect - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the Senior Java Enterprise Architect position.

With over 5 years of experience building and modernizing enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, backend architecture, and complex system integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, and available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your architecture goals.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
